card.title: Affiliate program
card.body: Share the pieces you love and earn a commission on every order your link brings in.

account.title: Become an affiliate
account.intro: Recommend us to your audience and earn on the orders you send our way.
account.point1: Get your own referral link and QR code, with sub-IDs to see what works.
account.point2: Follow clicks, orders and earnings in your affiliate dashboard.
account.point3: Earnings are confirmed once the return window has passed.
account.termsOutdated: Our affiliate terms have changed. Accept the new terms in your dashboard to keep earning.

PENDING.label: Under review
PENDING.body: Thanks for applying. We review every application and will email you once we've decided.

ACTIVE.label: Active
ACTIVE.body: You're an affiliate. Make links, follow your results and see your earnings in the dashboard.

SUSPENDED.label: Suspended
SUSPENDED.body: Your affiliate account is suspended for now. Contact us if you have questions.

REJECTED.label: Not approved
REJECTED.body: We weren't able to approve your application this time. Contact us if you have questions.

website.label: Website or social profile
website.hint: Where you'll share your links, for example instagram.com/yourname.

audience_size.label: Audience size
audience_size.hint: Roughly how many followers, subscribers or monthly visitors you have.

promotion_methods.label: How will you promote us?
promotion_methods.hint: For example reviews, styling videos or a newsletter.

terms.title: Accept the updated affiliate terms
terms.body: Our affiliate terms have changed. Accept the new terms to see your dashboard and keep earning.

errors.termsRequired: Accept the affiliate terms to continue.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.APPLY_FAILED: We couldn't send your application. Please try again.
errors.TERMS_FAILED: We couldn't record your acceptance. Please try again.
errors.CUSTOM_FIELDS_INVALID: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.FEATURE_DISABLED: The affiliate program isn't open right now.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The affiliate program isn't open right now.

overview.pendingNote: Waiting for the return window to pass
overview.subIdsCaption: Clicks and orders in the last 30 days for each sub-ID
overview.noActivity: No clicks or orders in the last 30 days yet. Share a link to get started.

links.title: Make a link
links.intro: Pick a page, add a sub-ID if you want to tell your channels apart, then copy the link or save the QR code.
links.noCodes: You don't have an active referral code yet.
links.label: Label
links.pageHint: A page of the store, starting with /, for example /products/leather-weekender-bag. Leave empty for the home page.
links.pageInvalid: Use a page of this store, starting with /.
links.subIdHint: A tag for where you share the link, for example instagram-bio. Shown in your stats.
links.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it yourself.
links.qrCaption: Scanning this code opens your link.

orders.title: Attributed orders
orders.privacy: Orders your links brought in. Shopper details are never shown.
orders.empty: No orders yet. They show up here once someone orders through your link.

earnings.title: Earnings
earnings.intro: Every commission, adjustment and reversal on your account.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.intro: Payouts of your approved cash earnings.
